# SPEC

## Scope

Update repository-controlled Digital Menu price displays and product documentation.

## Affected Areas

- Frontend pricing plan constants.
- README product pricing and task tracking.

## Technical Approach

Change the Plus plan amount strings from EUR 10/EUR 100 to EUR 12/EUR 120. Record the decision in README without changing checkout integration or product IDs.

## Assumptions

Annual pricing continues to equal ten monthly payments.

## Risks

External Polar pricing is outside repository control and remains a prerequisite for re-enabling checkout.
